'''Kindlabethia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="SoM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kindlabethia was only mentioned in ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', where it is said that a routing clerk "quietly offered for sale, to select parties from Kindlabethia to Nar Shaddaa, a hint to the route of the ''[[Corellian Queen]]''{{'s}} upcoming cruise..."<ref name="SoM" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' {{1stm}}
